module.title: Ice shelf cavities and ice-stream dynamics
entrypoints: verification/isomip (input, input.htd, input.icefront, input.obcs, input.stic, input.htd_ad, input.jn_ad, input.ad)
module.expensive_path: Ice-shelf boundary-layer thermodynamics (shelfice_thermodynamics.F, three-equation melt solve per cavity cell) and the streamice shallow-shelf viscous solve (streamice_vel_solve.F, a nonlinear Picard/CG iteration over the whole ice stream every step).
module.rationale: Ice-shelf and ice-stream physics share the sub-shelf boundary and are validated by the ISOMIP family; they have no overlap with sea ice.
excluded: shelfice_2d_remesh exercises dynamic remeshing with obcs; if too fragile it is left as an untested entry point
hazards: streamice has a nonlinear solver with iteration-count sensitivity; the floor must be measured
Only three decks: THIN unless isomip variants are used as separate checks

approval.human_ref: looks rather nice, lets go? (2026-09-02, all six modules approved; package mitgcm-seaice first)
